```{r}
reticulate::py_require("polars")
```

```{python}
import polars as pl
```

```{python}
basics = (
    pl.scan_csv(
        "title.basics0.tsv.gz",
        separator="\t",
        null_values="\\N",
        quote_char=None,
        infer_schema_length=0,
    )
    .select(["tconst", "titleType", "primaryTitle", "startYear", "genres"])
    .with_columns(pl.col("startYear").cast(pl.Int32))
)

ratings = (
    pl.scan_csv(
        "title.ratings.tsv.gz",
        separator="\t",
        null_values="\\N",
        quote_char=None,
        infer_schema_length=0,
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("averageRating").cast(pl.Float64),
        pl.col("numVotes").cast(pl.Int64),
    )
)

principals = (
    pl.scan_csv(
        "title.principals0.tsv.gz",
        separator="\t",
        null_values="\\N",
        quote_char=None,
        infer_schema_length=0,
    )
    .select(["tconst", "nconst", "category"])
)


filmes = basics.filter(pl.col("titleType") == "movie")
```

1.  Quais são os 5 filmes com as maiores notas (`averageRating`)? Apresente uma solução capaz de desempatar os filmes baseando-se no número de votos recebidos.

```{python}
q1 = (
    filmes
    .join(ratings, on="tconst", how="inner")
    .drop_nulls(["averageRating", "numVotes"])
    .sort(
        by=["averageRating", "numVotes", "tconst"],
        descending=[True, True, False],
    )
    .head(5)
    .select(["tconst", "primaryTitle", "startYear", "averageRating", "numVotes"])
    .collect()
)

print(q1)
```

2.  Qual é o gênero mais frequente entre os filmes com nota maior que 8?

```{python}
q2 = (
    filmes
    .join(ratings.filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 8), on="tconst", how="inner")
    .select(["tconst", pl.col("genres").str.split(",")])
    .explode("genres")
    .drop_nulls("genres")
    .group_by("genres")
    .agg(pl.len().alias("n_filmes"))
    .sort(by=["n_filmes", "genres"], descending=[True, False])
    .head(5)
    .collect()
)

print(q2)
```

3.  Quais são os 3 atores/atrizes que mais participaram de filmes com nota maior que 7.5?

```{python}
filmes_nota_alta = (
    filmes
    .join(ratings.filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 7.5), on="tconst", how="inner")
    .select("tconst")
)

q3 = (
    principals
    .filter(pl.col("category").is_in(["actor", "actress"]))
    .join(filmes_nota_alta, on="tconst", how="inner")
    .group_by("nconst")
    .agg(pl.col("tconst").n_unique().alias("n_filmes"))
    .sort(by=["n_filmes", "nconst"], descending=[True, False])
    .head(3)
    .collect()
)

print(q3)
```
